scope: Only dynasty_manual item icon; guide UI, contents, grant logic and item model unchanged
prompt: Create a replacement Minecraft Java item icon for an ORIGINAL ancient Chinese dynasty handbook, front-facing closed dark codex. Use case: stylized-concept, final in-game pixel sprite. The reference idea is the general readability of Goety's Black Book: substantial dark leather cover, clearly bound spine, pale thick page block and a strong contrasting cover ornament; DO NOT reproduce its exact artwork. Make this original book ink-black with restrained antique bronze binding and a simple square jade seal on the cover, compact and immediately recognizable as a BOOK, no letters. STRICT technical composition: square image that is a nearest-neighbor enlargement of EXACTLY a 16 by 16 logical pixel grid, not 32 or 64. Every logical pixel is a large perfect square. Every feature and every connected color region must be at least 2 by 2 logical pixels, no single-pixel thin lines. Design clean broad blocks. Exactly FOUR flat colors total: pure white #FFFFFF for background, ink-black #25242B for leather, antique bronze #B38A4C for binding/clasp, muted pale jade #B8C49B for seal and page block. Center the book with at least 2 complete white logical-pixel rows/columns on all four sides; no object or shadow touches canvas edges. Cover faces the viewer directly; closed book, clear broad spine at left and a visible 2-pixel-thick page block at bottom, simple 4x4 square jade seal centered on the upper/middle cover. No perspective tilt, no gradients, no highlights, no noise, no antialiasing, no smooth edges, no grid lines, no drop shadows, no text, no frame. Output only the finished sprite.
referenceUse: Viewed official 16x16 sprite in browser: dark cover, pale page block, compact bound-book silhouette. Original artwork not copied.
normalization: ImageMagick crop 660x760+310+230; point-sample 6x6; nearest four-color remap without dither; one white macro-pixel border; nearest resize16x16
